experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (ratified -- see DR-005, issue #1)' rows 'Output reference' (1.20 V +/-2% untrimmed, 3sigma mismatch MC N>=300 + process corners, -40...125 degC) and 'Temp coefficient (-40...125 degC)' (< 50 ppm/degC), for the 3.3 V primary flavor (DR-001). Measures design/bandgap_core.sch open-circuit, untrimmed (no trim network -- that is issue #13), across process and supply corners with temperature swept continuously inside the deck. This bench is the corner-matrix half of the ratified claim (see statistical_convention below); the 3sigma mismatch-MC half is issue #12's sim/monte-carlo-untrimmed bench.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix claim, not a distribution claim -- untrimmed spread from local mismatch is issue #12's Monte Carlo)
experiment.title: Untrimmed output reference and box-method temperature coefficient over -40..125 degC

spread_checks.note: VREF(27 degC) must move by at least 0.1 mV across the process/supply matrix. A dead-flat result across 15 corner points means the corner include or the supply param is not reaching the simulator.
